This period

Owls: Great Horned Owl was detected 6 times, 5 of them between 2:41 AM PT and 4:43 AM PT, with a best confidence of 81.8% at 2:41 AM PT. Northern Pygmy-Owl was detected twice: at 5:13 PM PT (88.9%) and at 10:36 PM PT (72.9%). This species is rare at Marymoor. All owl detections should be verified from the audio clip.

Overall: 725 detections of 49 species at Marymoor Park Station, 73 of them at night. Several species are unusual for Marymoor and may be misidentifications: Black-billed Magpie (88.9%), Mountain Chickadee (85.4%), Cassin's Finch (67.2%), American Tree Sparrow (60.0%) and Herring Gull (59.5%). These should be verified from the audio clip.

Coverage: Recordings with detections cover an estimated 4 h 43 min of the 12 hours between civil dusk (6:55 PM PT) and civil dawn (6:53 AM PT), about 39%. The longest stretch with no recording with detections runs from 7:00 PM PT to 9:30 PM PT. Coverage is estimated from detections, so silent recordings are not counted.

Recording coverage

Each block is 15 minutes; bar height is the number of detections. Shaded blocks are the hours between civil dusk and civil dawn, the window for owl work. Coverage is estimated from the detections: a block counts as recorded when a recording in it has at least one detection, so a recording in which BirdNET heard nothing looks the same as a gap. All times are Pacific Time.
